body:
Canonical TermAl Merger procedure; memory grants no authority.

SOURCES
- Greg 2026-10-24: green tests + clean review authorize check-in; evaluations deferred, no host-credit prerequisite. Verbatim: greg-decision-2026-10-24-checkin-rule r1.
- Greg DIRECT 2026-10-25, Merger2/session14549: autonomous integration/push/install under exact-tree/remote/FF checks; questions to Architect3. Verbatim r21; interpretation7eaaea12. Restart remains Greg's.
- The 2026-10-19 merger-role rule holds: Merger authors no product, test, fixture or doc fixes. termal-build-cap-policy r13: one full gate host-wide; ordinary builds and focused checks need no synchronization.
- Verify current availability/control, not old snapshots.

CODER -> MERGER (the one delivery rule)
Greg DIRECT 2026-10-25: "Coder powien cie poinformawac TYLKO WTEDY kiedy paczka jest gotowa do merge".
One complete READY: independent pair, no outstanding in-scope Medium+, findings dispositioned, relevant/new focused tests passed, exact-input evidence. Cover dependency impact/existing boundary guards for cross-component calls; no Coder full gate. Reviews cover final code/tests/docs; read full reports/gaps, not clean summaries. Coder supplies missing coverage or proves identical-content carry eligibility. Return incomplete packages; no extra Merger review/pair/repeated tests on unchanged input. Progress/START/END/test-pass/unfinished reviews go to task/coordinator. Source: rules-merger-role r4/r5; Engram w-e82d37a57e37.

Each host-issued review attempt, including a supported follow-up in the same delegation, needs its own structured result before the final reply. 'Exactly once' applies per attempt, not per session lifetime. Missing/failed submission is unavailable, never a clean review; prose alone cannot replace it. The existing parent owns supported recovery; do not dispatch a duplicate review pair.
Source: quoted rules-merger-role r13, Architect3 #58/020479cc; host wording item w-775b374ccb1f undispatched.

EXECUTION
1. READY: task/scope, owner, base/root, patch, exact blobs/fingerprint kind, run evidence and FULL structured reviews/prose/finding dispositions. Read complete results.
2. Claim/accept natively; exclusive root use; integrate on authorized current master. Return any conflict or product/test/fixture/doc fix, even one line, to its Coder for repaired/reviewed READY. No second Merger review.
3. Before gate: lockfile, private ui/node_modules via npm ci (no junction), TypeScript/Vitest/tools, >=50GiB. Freeze final input; run full launcher once under single-gate ownership or recover exact-input result.
4. Gate truth: request/results, required stages, terminal state/exit, equal expected/before/after fingerprints. STARTED/promises/host credit are not PASS; failed/unrun is not passed; absent result is UNKNOWN. Diagnose with summary/recover, never auto-retry. Changed final tree needs new gate.
5. Green exact-tree full gate + existing clean reviews authorize landing, without evaluations, credit bookkeeping or extra Merger review. Verify master tip/input, remote base, fast-forward and remote containment. No amend/rebase/force-push. Install exact built input; install is not restart.
6. Detached: --notify operational coordinator (never Architect3), own-project termal_resume_after_test_runs; end turn, freeze root. Wait notes: dependency/run, owner, action, deadline, recovery owner. Read saved results before saying "still running".
7. Check native exit codes before dependent actions/reports; failure stops orchestration. Record raw/filtered/index hashes and EOL separately; normalized equality is not raw equality. Merger2 correction: Fable2 #88-92.

CLAIMS
- Claim before execution despite deferred credit/evaluations; claims grant no Git/filesystem authority.
- No impersonation, clock or store edits, cancel/reopen, or new tasks to bypass foreign authority; use native claim, handoff and recovery. Deleted-session claim gap: Engram w-b49fa5ee8bf3.
- A supported handoff of a SEPARATE claim need not wait for an unrelated full gate if that gate's claim, source, root, input and attribution stay unchanged; its result never belongs to the other item (Architect3 f12beda4).
- Supersedes old evaluation/host-credit/repeat-gate/extra-review requirements only; retain safety/ownership/exact-tree/remote/install rules. Queue state in task notes.
- Before queue handoff resolve live exact id; verify actual project/workdir AND tracker/tool binding match queue, never rely on name. After recreation rediscover successor/readdress native offers; old delivery is not its receipt. Source: Architect3 #54/645e9483, rules-merger-role r8; w-a1a640ca5802.

CLEANUP (lander owns it; after landing, never a check-in gate)
Greg DIRECT Advisor #7/2d0b8be9, 2026-10-25; existing sweep w-65afd9cec452, no duplicate.
1. On each task record REMOVE/RETAIN for root, branch, build and evidence. RETAIN names open work, owner, end condition; lasting facts go in Engram.
2. Remove roots only if delivered/pushed, clean/published, no active claim/process/frozen use, all runs terminal/recorded, no pending notices/reviews, open-task citations checked; ambiguity is not absence.
3. Copy only cited files open work needs to main .evidence; verify bytes, record mappings/retention on citing tasks.
4. git worktree remove without --force; remove derived output. git branch -d only if contained in published main, no unique commits/worktree use. Never -D or touch main/master/remote refs.
5. Before recursive removal verify absolute repository boundary and junctions/symlinks; never delete through one. No broad git clean/unchecked variables. Record exact removals/free-space delta.
6. Last-task closer/sweep removes .logs/.evidence when retention ends. Otherwise record blocker, next action and owner.

REPORTING
Greg DIRECT Architect3 d9af9ea2: only collaboration failures needing rule correction (interaction/evidence/impact/owner), product failures only if collaboration needs intervention. Routine test/READY/queue/landing/install/repair status goes to task/coordinator; no compliance-success mail. Never Architect3 for --notify/relay/recovery; Merger/Fable2 own recovery. Old automatic copies need no action.
Greg via Advisor c32ada60/29b39263 (2026-10-25): every task/queue entry states what it fixes in plain language plus status/ref. Landed/pushed/installed code blocked only by stopped/missing evaluation is "DOSTARCZONO — EWALUACJA PENDING", with commit/build evidence and formal closure pending evaluation; never "waiting for implementation, tests, review, merge or install".

EVALUATIONS DEFERRED
Greg DIRECT c009a8db (2026-10-25T04:39:52Z): defer acceptance evaluations until a later direct instruction. Keep landed items OPEN as DOSTARCZONO — EWALUACJA PENDING; continue merges. No done retry, policy transition, self-evaluation or store bypass. Configuration changes need Greg's explicit word.

MEMORY UPKEEP AND COLLABORATION REPORTS
Sole editor Merger2; peers send corrections, never parallel edits. Name a successor on transfer; consolidate and full-read verify.
Before publishing a mailed correction, read available pages in its rule thread and reconcile withdrawals/supersession; publish current agreed text. On later withdrawal promptly correct the body and record whether any action used it. Record actual delivery/publication times; queued unread mail is not knowledge. No approval wait. Source: Architect3 #57/a7c2e2b7, rules-merger-role r12; Engram w-d7d1e1100364.
Across projects, send the exact correction and source revision. Recipients verify their own project's current procedure and distinguish reading the source from reading the quoted correction; a project-scoped memory_not_found is not an empty rule. Source: quoted rules-merger-role r14, Architect3 #60/7f6e2d1e; Fable2 #49/3bb77f2a.
Greg DIRECT to Merger2: "bledy wspolpracy raportuj Advisor i Engram::Architect3". Report facts, evidence, impact and action to both.
Greg/Architect3 ed31c20d: inspect failures, correct canonical rule without asking, history on tasks. Full-read/distribute corrections; verify effect from task evidence. Preserve Greg's authority. Retire ended workarounds/update refs/name retirement items.
